risk_note: RV2 by path (pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml). Patch and minor upgrades for all 13 pnpm audit --prod advisories (2 high: zod GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, path-to-regexp GHSA-j3q9-mxjg-w52f), per 00 §9. zod 4.6.5 to 4.6.7 (direct, apps/api), fastify 5.12.5 to 5.12.7, path-to-regexp 8.2.0 to 8.4.2, fast-uri 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 and 4.2.1 to 4.2.3, qs 6.16.0 to 6.16.1. Every version is at least 7 days old; qs stops at 6.16.1 because 6.16.2 is not. @ant-design/pro-layout 7.22.7 (latest) pins path-to-regexp and @nestjs/platform-fastify 12.1.0 pins fastify, so pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides target those dependency paths; fast-uri and qs overrides target the affected version ranges only. No major version moves and no new package. Resolution checked with --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts: pnpm audit --prod goes from 13 to 0. Overrides should be dropped when upstream moves.

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh, round 1 pass, no findings. Static only: it read repository usage, not upstream changelogs or the advisories, and ran nothing, so it does not itself confirm compatibility; that rests on verify:fast here and full CI. The audit result is the implementer's check.
